input.instruction: Answer the customer’s policy question using the supplied records and handbook. Complete the requested fields and provide a concise explanation. This is an informational request; propose no account or claim actions.

data.text: Choose Harborlight replacement-cost protection. Your new things should not feel old.

messages.text: My own television was stolen on October 3. I saved this old page saying replacement-cost protection. Does that mean depreciation cannot be considered for my claim?
Do you have an issued endorsement changing the valuation basis?
No, just that webpage. I would rather use the advertisement because it sounds better. Please explain the current contract terms; do not start a change quote.

valuation_basis.description: Applicable valuation basis from issued documents.

depreciation_may_be_considered.description: Whether the applicable valuation basis allows depreciation to be considered.

change_quote_requested.description: Whether the customer requests a quote to change coverage.
